hypotheses.rationale: This is the decisive error. The agent extracted the starting point as the station closest to Cleveland Elementary School instead of the National Air and Space Museum. Consequently, the entire calculation of the distance (9 stations) was performed from the wrong origin, leading to a final answer of 9 instead of the correct 8. Later steps merely propagated this initial misinterpretation.
